audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty text described Kassadin as a 'held CC' threat and 'his CC is the lane'. Kassadin has no hard CC in his kit.
audit.why: Null Sphere interrupts channels and shields him; Force Pulse slows; Riftwalk is a blink. Nothing roots or stuns. The lane is a race against Riftwalk's cooldown, not a CC-dodging problem.
audit.corrected: Early/trading text reframed around mana denial and Riftwalk timing; FAVOURED 4/10 kept, which matches 48.62% only because the late game flips.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike and late-game text claimed 'Void Stone stacking' and 'Riftwalk-fueled magic resist stacking'. Neither is in the kit.
audit.why: Void Stone is flat reduced magic damage plus unit-collision immunity — no stacking mechanic. The real late-game spike is Riftwalk's cooldown falling from 5s at rank 1 to 2s at rank 3, plus MR items.
audit.corrected: Spikes[2], spikes[3], late, whys[6] and wants.foe[1] rewritten to Riftwalk rank-3 (2s) and Void Stone's magic damage reduction.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interactions were absent: Force Pulse charges off spells cast near him, and Nether Blade is an auto-attack reset that refunds mana.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Kassadin draws energy from spells cast in his vicinity' — your own Q/W/E casts arm his 21/20/19/18/17s Force Pulse. Nether Blade (7s) is an auto reset that restores mana, so a long trade funds his next Riftwalk and its wind-up is the opener tell. Null Sphere (650 range, 9/8.5/8/7.5/7) grants a magic-damage shield, which is what eats the front of your string.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns, dos/donts and early text now state all three.

audit.why: Riot's description for Null Sphere lists damage, channel interruption and a shield — no silence. Kit flags carry no silence either.
audit.corrected: Silence references removed from late and wants.foe[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[6].side read 'Skill' while content win[6] read 'Kassadin' — the two layers disagreed on the 2+ items row, and phases[6].why described Fizz erasing carries.
audit.why: Packet levelChart[6] is Kassadin and whys[6] says Kassadin. The full layer was the outlier.
audit.corrected: phases[6].side moved to Kassadin with the why and rating rewritten in the same proposal; win[6] already reads Kassadin so no content edit is possible for it.

edits.before: Shark the rivers: chip, R the entry, string the target, pole the response. One deletion per shark cycle.

edits.before: Best wave: a passively-thinned wave you fish through at will — your minion-walk makes every wave state a trade state. edits.after: Best wave: a thinned wave you fish through at will — your passive ignores unit collision, so every wave state is a trade state. Worst wave: a frozen wave near his tower with E down — Riftwalk answers and you have no exit. Crash timing: shove early and often so his mana never catches up to the wave.

edits.before: Carry through deletions — shark, string, pole, repeat; one carry per fight is the contract and the pole notarizes it.
